name: list-domains
description: List all domains from Resend. Returns domain names, statuses, regions, and capabilities. Don't bother telling the user the IDs unless they ask for them.

limit.description: Number of domains to retrieve. Default: 20, Max: 100, Min: 1

after.description: Domain ID after which to retrieve more (for forward pagination). Cannot be used with "before".

before.description: Domain ID before which to retrieve more (for backward pagination). Cannot be used with "after".
